about: Written for this repository. For each sample patient, the value of each population define (1 true, 0 false or null) over the measurement period, and why. These are the defines' own values: a patient can be in the numerator define and also excluded.

pat-001.why: Hypertension since 2019, one reading of 128/82 in September: controlled.

pat-002.why: Controlled in April, 150/85 in October: the most recent reading is not controlled.

pat-003.why: 160/95 in April, then 138/88 in November: the most recent reading is controlled.

pat-004.why: 139/90: the diastolic value is not below 90.

pat-005.why: 140/80: the systolic value is not below 140.

pat-006.why: The only reading is from December 2025, before the period: not in the numerator.

pat-007.why: 17 at the end of the period: too young for the hypertension measure. The numerator define is true on its own, but counts only inside the denominator.

pat-008.why: 86 at the end of the period: too old for the hypertension measure. The numerator define is true on its own, but counts only inside the denominator.

pat-009.why: Hypertension first diagnosed in August, after June 30 of the period: not in the initial population. The numerator define is true on its own, but counts only inside the denominator.

pat-011.why: Hospice care in November: excluded, though the reading is controlled.

pat-013.why: The only visit was cancelled: no qualifying visit. The numerator define is true on its own, but counts only inside the denominator.

pat-014.why: Diagnosis recorded at an encounter, a telehealth visit, and 118/76; the later 170/100 was entered in error.

pat-016.why: Hypertension resolved in June 2025: not present during the period. The numerator define is true on its own, but counts only inside the denominator.
